text:
tara: Quick final coordination for next Wed's announce. Must have by EOD: changelog permalink, docs preview with runnable snippets, precise canary windows, and HubSpot routing rule name. Embargo 14:00 UTC. Can eng confirm rollout plan + thresholds? @vik
vik: Yes. Proposed ramp: 2% x 12m -> 15% x 25m -> 60% x 20m -> 100% if green. Abort if 5xx > 0.7% OR p95 > 330ms. I'll paste the canary checklist and rollback commands shortly.
drew: Docs preview is live: https://docs.redwood.ai/previews/290. Includes curl + node quickstarts and an examples section. I'll swap the model name after you confirm.
tara: Marketing will pull that preview into the blog draft. We also need two micro-bullets for the header: p95 delta and token-cost delta. Can eng paste quick numbers?
anik: (ana chiming in) Growth wants the webinar reg link in the CTA and tracking UTMs. Plan: T+0 blog, T+10 thread, T+45 clip, T+60 webinar CTA share. Webinar landing: https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-benchmark ?utm_campaign=announce_q4
vik: Benchmarks from perf-run: p50=70ms, p95=210ms, token-cost ~ -8% on RLHF baseline. Use: "p95 down to ~210ms; token cost ~8% lower for long-context pipelines." Changelog draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/zzq901. Blurb: "Adaptive prefix caching + smarter batching reduce tail latency and token cost for long-context workloads."
tara: Perfect. For inbound: use HubSpot tag `launch_q4_stream`. Routing: tag -> marketing/sdr queue; rule: usage>80 reqs/day -> escalate to sales/webhook. Can product paste rule ID?
drew: I'll ensure docs include the exact model string and quickstart snippet once vik confirms `rwd-serve-v3`.
vik: Confirm model `rwd-serve-v3`. APAC staged 45m after full global rollout. I'll schedule a 15m dry-run T-30m before publish (dashboard + demo). Checklist I'll bring: canary traffic, p50/p95, error rate, top traces, rollback commands.
deploy-bot: [deploy-schedule] canary requested by vik for 2026-12-09T13:20:00Z
tara: Can we get a 1-line eng quote for the blog header? Short and simple.
vik: "This rollout lowers tail latency and token cost for long-context inference by combining adaptive prefix caching with workload-aware batching." Use as-is.
tara: Great. I'll lock the blog and schedule the T-30m embargo ping in #marketing. :rocket:
